subject.title: Browser control node capability stuck in warning state, never approves (v0.6.12)

question: Should Windows Hub remove or disable the Browser control node-capability UI until it is fully supported, or should the project commit to implementing browser routing and approval for remote Windows nodes?
rationale: Current Windows-node documentation omits Browser control, but the reported UI presents it as an ordinary enabled capability. Choosing between an honest unsupported state and a supported cross-component capability is a product and platform-contract decision.

options.title: Hide or disable the unsupported control
options.body: Make the Permissions UI and approved-capability list reflect the documented Windows-node support set, with a focused regression test.

options.title: Sponsor full remote browser support
options.body: Define and implement the gateway, browser-host authentication, approval, documentation, and end-to-end proof needed for Windows nodes to serve browser requests.

recommendation.title: Hide or disable the unsupported control
recommendation.body: Make the Permissions UI and approved-capability list reflect the documented Windows-node support set, with a focused regression test.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies him with the Windows node project; this is a low-confidence routing signal pending feature-history confirmation.
